summary.description: One line: what was implemented. No preamble, no restatement of the brief.

files_changed.description: Repository-relative paths written. index.html is generated by npm run build and belongs here when the build ran.

deviations.description: Anything done differently from the entry's Requirements, or 'none'. A requirement that could not be met belongs here, not in summary.

tests_run.description: The exact command run to verify, and whether every suite passed.
